title: Medplus Health Services Ltd - 543427 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: MedPlus adds 218 net stores in Q4 (800 planned for FY27) with store-level margins of 13.1% and mature-store SSSG of 17.8%, but management refuses margin guidance and is shifting growth to franchisees.
